verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const f="lib/connections/introductions.ts";if(!fs.existsSync(f)){console.error("SCAN-716: "+f+" missing");process.exit(79)}const s=fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8");const i=s.indexOf("async function claimIntroductionRewards");if(i<0){console.error("SCAN-716: claimIntroductionRewards not found");process.exit(79)}const j=s.indexOf("\n}",i);const body=s.slice(i,j<0?s.length:j);if(/revalidatePath\(/.test(body)){console.error("SCAN-716: claimIntroductionRewards still calls revalidatePath, and its only caller is the Friends page rendering it as a Server Component, so the one load that pays an introduction reward throws during render and shows the error boundary instead of the +Gems banner.");process.exit(1)}'

append.detail: claimIntroductionRewards ended with revalidatePath('/network/friends') when a reward was paid, but its only caller is the async Server Component PeopleMode on the Friends page, which awaits it during render; Next throws from revalidatePath while workUnitStore.phase is render, so the single load that paid an introduction reward rendered network/error.tsx instead of the +Gems banner (the gems were already awarded and the row already stamped, so a reload showed nothing). Removed that line with a comment explaining why; createIntroduction, a real action, keeps its revalidatePath. Pinned in lib/connections/introductions.test.ts: a paid reward returns { rewarded: 1, gems: 15 } and never calls revalidatePath, an empty pending list returns zero, and createIntroduction still revalidates.
